def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # --- validation ---
    if not all(isinstance(x, np.ndarray) for x in (logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_call_only.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("input matrices must have the same shape")
    n, h = logp_with_result.shape
    if n == 0:
        return np.array([], dtype=bool), np.array([], dtype=float)
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result) & np.isfinite(logp_call_only) & np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("input matrices must contain only finite values")
    if not np.all((logp_with_result <= 0) & (logp_call_only <= 0) & (logp_no_call <= 0)):
        raise ValueError("input matrices must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be numeric, not bool")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # --- normalize decreasing future‑token weights ---
    t = np.arange(h, dtype=float)
    raw = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    w_sum = np.sum(raw)
    if w_sum <= 0:
        raise ValueError("future horizon must be positive")
    weights = raw / w_sum  # shape (h,)

    # --- compute weighted future‑token losses ---
    L_plus = -np.sum(weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)       # (n,)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)        # (n,)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)    # (n,)

    # --- stronger counterfactual baseline ---
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # --- margin and threshold ---
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
